summary: Sprint A+B (Trip.home_location/has_return + Expense.expense_date) tested end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/sprint_ab_test.py — 19/19 passing (create/patch validation, RBAC 403, list fields, route-geometry return_leg incl. null cases, expense_date default/validation/sort, regression on stops/attractions/hotels/expenses/members/exchange-rates/notifications/route-geometry/openapi). Backfill script verified (2 seeded legacy expenses populated from stop.start_date / trip.start_date, re-run = 0 updates). ORS-unreachable fallback verified with ORS_MOCK=1 (geojson=null, distance_m=1912900 haversine) and ORS_MOCK restored to 0. Frontend Playwright: CreateTripModal return collapsible + inline error + disabled submit + trip creation, EditTripModal prepopulate/validate/save, StopCard badges (Start / Stop 1 / Destination and single-stop 'Start & Destination'), Trip '↩ BACK HOME' chip (with tooltip 'Return home to Roma, Italy') and hidden when has_return=false, TripMap home divIcon + 'Back home' legend chip + home popup (Roma, Italy) + 7 interactive paths, ExpenseModal date input min/max/default=trip.start_date, ExpensesSection date-desc ordering with date cells. Two frontend defects found (see below).

minor.issue: 5 pre-existing orphan expense docs reference deleted trips (from earlier iterations). trips DELETE cascade code is correct; only legacy rows affected. Backfill logs a WARNING and skips them each run.

ui_bugs.issue: In-progress edits are wiped by background sync: useEffect([open, trip]) re-runs whenever Trip.jsx's useTripSync/loadAll produces a new trip object (any version bump, e.g. another member adds an expense). Reproduced: typed title 'SPRINTAB_UI Future solo EDITED' and home 'Sintra' reverted to server values within ~12s, and the 'Return home' section collapsed mid-edit. Fix: reset form only when `open` transitions false→true (or key on trip.trip_id).

Out-of-range date submit never shows the inline error. The native date input carries min/max, so Chrome's constraint validation blocks form submission (validationMessage: 'Value must be 09/24/2026 or earlier.') and the React check that sets 'Date must be within trip range (…)' in [data-testid=expense-modal-error] is unreachable. Add noValidate to the form (or validate on change) so the app-level message renders.
data-testid="trip-map-container" is never present in the DOM — react-leaflet MapContainer does not forward unknown props. Verified via .leaflet-container instead. Testability gap only.

issues: Native browser date pickers used instead of the shadcn calendar component (pre-existing pattern across the app, consistent but off-design).

action_items: EditTripModal: stop resetting form state on background trip refetch (guard the useEffect on open transition / trip_id) — currently loses user input.
ExpenseModal: make the inline out-of-range date error reachable (form noValidate or onChange validation) so [data-testid=expense-modal-error] shows 'Date must be within trip range …'.
TripMap: attach trip-map-container testid to a real DOM wrapper (MapContainer prop is dropped by react-leaflet).
critical_code_review_comments: expenses.py PATCH: ExpenseUpdate.expense_date is Optional, so an explicit {"expense_date": null} passes validation and writes null, violating the 'mandatory expense_date' contract (Expense model would then 500 on serialize). Reject null explicitly.
map_routes.py::route_geometry — trip may be None (deleted trip after permission check) and is only guarded inside _build_return_leg; fine today but consider an explicit 404.
trip_map_test.py had a strict key-set assertion on route-geometry; updated to allow the new return_leg field (test-only change).
seed_data_creation: sprint_ui@twt.app: trip 'SPRINTAB_UI Roma loop' (trip_b0fd06b42e004648, has_return + Roma home, 3 stops, 3 dated expenses), 'SPRINTAB_UI Future solo' (trip_2e4b1a62f49340b4, future range, 1 stop, has_return enabled via UI to Napoli), 'SPRINTAB_UI Created' (created through CreateTripModal). sprint_ab@twt.app test trips are auto-cleaned by the pytest fixture.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/dev-login {email} (ENV=dev) — sprint_ab@twt.app (backend), sprint_ui@twt.app (UI seeds); /api/auth/dev-login-as used for editor-role 403 test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/sprint_ab_test.py -q`. ORS_MOCK is back to 0 in /app/backend/.env (verify before/after any mock toggling). Playwright login pattern: page.evaluate fetch('/api/auth/dev-login', credentials:'include') then goto /trip/<id>. TripMap is expanded by default (localStorage tripmap-open-<tripId>); do NOT click trip-map-toggle before asserting map elements, and assert .leaflet-container / .twt-map-home / [data-testid=map-legend-return] instead of trip-map-container. Re-verify EditTripModal form-reset bug by triggering a version bump (create an expense via fetch) while the modal is open.
rca_of_the_issue: EditTripModal reset: Trip.jsx polls via useTripSync and calls loadAll() on version change, producing a new `trip` object; EditTripModal's useEffect dependency array [open, trip] therefore re-runs setForm()/setReturnOpen() while the dialog is open, discarding user input. ExpenseModal: the date <input type="date"> has min/max attributes and the surrounding form has no noValidate, so the browser's constraint validation aborts submit before React's handleSubmit runs, making the app-level range error message dead code.
